clue.text: This airborne missile is a rattler!

definitions.meaning: an American air-to-air guided missile carries this name
a small North American rattlesnake that moves by sideways looping

explanation.definitionFit: The name belongs both to a heat-seeking air-to-air weapon and to a desert rattlesnake that travels sideways.

clue.text: Wear for one of the British Isles

definitions.meaning: a Scots and northern word for a shirt or chemise
a small Channel Island near Guernsey

explanation.definitionFit: The word is an old Scots name for a shirt and also names a tiny Channel Island.

clue.text: Facts given positive expression by Russian army

parts.note: da is the Russian word for yes
TA is the Territorial Army, Britain's volunteer reserve

explanation.surface: Information is confirmed by the Russian military.
explanation.definitionFit: Facts gathered for study or calculation are information, plural in Latin form.

clue.text: Spasmodic affliction dictators are free from

definitions.text: Spasmodic affliction dictators are free from

parts.words: Spasmodic affliction dictators are free from
parts.note: dictators here are people who dictate letters to a secretary, so they never suffer the hand cramp that comes from long penmanship

explanation.surface: Tyrants are somehow immune to a convulsive illness.
explanation.definitionFit: A cramp of the hand muscles brought on by long spells of penmanship.

clue.text: Jules in trouble as writer? Surely not!

indicators.note: something in trouble is in disorder, so the surname's letters are jumbled

parts.note: Jules Verne, the French novelist, which 'as writer' confirms

explanation.surface: Is the French novelist really in difficulties? Impossible!
explanation.walkthrough: 'as writer' points from Jules to his surname VERNE; 'in trouble' jumbles it.
explanation.definitionFit: An exclamation of disbelief means 'not ever', an emphatic denial.

clue.text: Charm oriental partner, maybe, introducing a kind of turn

parts.note: E stands for east, the oriental direction

indicators.note: the shuffled letters take in another piece, introducing it into their middle
maybe signals that the word partner is only one possible arrangement of its letters

parts.note: a U-turn, so the letter U

explanation.surface: Win over an eastern spouse by bringing in a particular manoeuvre.
explanation.walkthrough: 'maybe' rearranges PARTNER to NRAPTRE; 'introducing' puts U inside it after the T.
explanation.definitionFit: To delight someone utterly, filling them with rapture.

clue.text: A house which (to adapt a proverb) is better than none at all

definitions.text: A house which (to adapt a proverb) is better than none at all

parts.words: A house which (to adapt a proverb) is better than none at all
parts.note: the proverb says half a loaf is better than no bread, so half a house beats no house

explanation.surface: A dwelling that a twisted saying prefers to having nothing.
explanation.definitionFit: A semi-detached house shares a wall with its neighbour, half of a pair of homes.

clue.text: Choose lad in charge of modern type of music

parts.note: to choose by vote is to elect
Ron, a boy's name

explanation.surface: Pick the boy to run a contemporary musical style.
explanation.definitionFit: Music made with synthesisers and computers is a recent genre.

clue.text: Shameless little devil, Ninette, spoiled too

parts.note: an imp is a small mischievous devil

indicators.note: spoiled suggests the name Ninette is ruined and its letters disordered

explanation.surface: A naughty child, Ninette has been indulged as well.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spoiled' turns NINETTE into ENITENT; 'too' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone without remorse feels no shame for wrongdoing.

clue.text: Game-dogs have a great day among mongrel terriers

indicators.note: among puts one piece in the middle of the other
a mongrel is of mixed breed, so the letters of terriers are mixed

parts.note: VE Day, Victory in Europe, a great day in 1945

explanation.surface: Gundogs enjoy a celebration in a pack of crossbred terriers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mongrel' looks like a description of the dogs, but it signals the reshuffle; VE Day (8 May 1945) is the great day that goes 'among' the letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Retrievers are breeds trained to fetch shot birds for hunters.

clue.text: Rope for hanging pot

definitions.meaning: a fibre once used for the hangman's rope

explanation.definitionFit: The plant's fibre makes rope, and the same plant gives cannabis, slang pot.

clue.text: Stately edifice ordered by Chinese emperor

definitions.text: Stately edifice ordered by Chinese emperor

parts.words: Stately edifice ordered by Chinese emperor
parts.note: Coleridge's Kubla Khan opens with the Mongol emperor of China decreeing a stately building at Xanadu

explanation.surface: An imposing building commissioned by an Eastern ruler.
explanation.definitionFit: Coleridge's poem has Kubla Khan decree a stately palace of delight in Xanadu.

clue.text: What a capital chap Bishop is!

definitions.text: What a capital chap Bishop is!

parts.words: What a capital chap Bishop is!
parts.note: capital chap means a city dweller, and a senior bishop over a province bears the same title

explanation.surface: An exclamation praising a splendid fellow named Bishop.
explanation.definitionFit: The word describes a big-city person and an archbishop presiding over a province.

clue.text: They supply the Navy, their Petty Officers making shift on board

indicators.note: on board means inside the vessel, so the jumbled letters go inside

parts.note: the vessel boarded is a steamship, SS

indicators.note: making shift means moving about, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: the word their followed by POS, the plural abbreviation for petty officers, all eight letters going into the mix

explanation.surface: Navy supply vessels whose petty officers improvise aboard.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on board' is the convention for going inside SS, a steamship; 'making shift' rearranges the letters of 'their' with the abbreviation for Petty Officers, which the setter puts into the mix.
explanation.definitionFit: Vessels that carry provisions to a fleet are supply ships.

clue.text: Faced girl student going round north promenade

indicators.note: the student surrounds the other pieces, going round them

parts.note: a co-ed is a female student at a mixed college
a seafront is a front, the promenade

explanation.surface: A female undergraduate circled the seafront walk and met it head-on.
explanation.definitionFit: To be met or challenged directly by something.

clue.text: Tender initially by Jean Jacques for hitching gear

indicators.note: initially takes just the opening letter of tender

parts.note: Jean-Jacques Rousseau, the French philosopher

explanation.surface: A proposal first offered by a French philosopher for towing equipment.
explanation.definitionFit: A bride's clothes and linen, gathered for getting hitched, that is married.

clue.text: Next poem I composed, "Freedom"

indicators.note: composed means put together in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A poet announces the title of their next work.
explanation.definitionFit: Exemption is release from a duty or charge, a kind of liberty.

clue.text: Round of a fight

parts.note: a boxing match is a bout

explanation.surface: One stage of a boxing match.
explanation.definitionFit: Around and about are synonyms, both meaning in a circle near something.

clue.text: Hand over coming and going

indicators.note: coming and going says the word reads the same in either direction

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: Pass something on as people arrive and leave.
explanation.definitionFit: To pass a matter on to another person or body for decision.

clue.text: Topping performance!

definitions.meaning: slang for killing, especially by hanging
the carrying out of a piece of music or a task

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both putting someone to death and the skill shown in playing or doing something.

clue.text: Airborne Marine type is a troublemaker

definitions.meaning: a small seabird that flies over open ocean

explanation.definitionFit: The seabird was thought to herald storms, so the name also means a person who brings trouble.

clue.text: The single right which makes them possessive

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: One entitlement that turns people into owners.
explanation.definitionFit: The possessive determiner for 'them' is the one meaning belonging to those people.

clue.text: It's a case for a bit of private tuition

indicators.note: for a bit says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Someone justifies a short spell of personal coaching.
explanation.definitionFit: A small ornamental holder for needles and pins.

clue.text: Albanian composer goes scot-free

parts.note: Albanian freed of a Scot (Ian) leaves Alban, the first name of an Austrian composer, whose surname is wanted

explanation.surface: A Balkan musician escapes without punishment.
explanation.definitionFit: Alban Berg was an Austrian composer of the Second Viennese School.

clue.text: First nine letters returned, the last from Athens

indicators.note: returned means the letters run backwards

parts.note: the first nine letters of the alphabet run A to I

explanation.surface: The opening nine characters came back, with the final one from Greece.
explanation.walkthrough: The Greek letter wanted is the ninth, the last of the first nine letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Iota is the ninth Greek letter, so the last of the first nine in Athens.

clue.text: Methuselah, for example, is worth two of Jeroboam

definitions.text: Methuselah, for example, is worth two of Jeroboam

parts.words: Methuselah, for example, is worth two of Jeroboam
parts.note: these biblical names are also large bottle sizes, the larger holding twice the smaller

explanation.surface: An ancient patriarch is valued at double a biblical king.
explanation.definitionFit: Methuselah and Jeroboam are names for big champagne vessels, eight and four standard bottles.

clue.text: No such team finishes at Twickenham

definitions.text: No such team finishes at Twickenham

parts.words: No such team finishes at Twickenham
parts.note: in rugby the referee calls 'no ...' to end a match, and a team is also called this

explanation.surface: No team like this ever completes a game at the rugby ground.
explanation.walkthrough: Twickenham is the home of English rugby union; 'no side' is the old call ending a rugby match.
explanation.definitionFit: A team is a side, and 'no side' ends a rugby game.

clue.text: A relatively limited generation shows good manners at home

parts.note: in means at home
good breeding means good manners

explanation.surface: A narrow family line shows its polish at home.
explanation.definitionFit: Producing offspring from close relatives, a limited genetic line.
